column1: # THE MEDIA MODEL LICENCE REGISTER. One row per fetched FILE. Every media fetch
# a file not listed here is not fetched. TAB-separated, no interpreter.
#   name      short model name (matches the tier table's model column parts)
#   revision  pinned commit sha, never a branch
#   sha256    the file's LFS sha256, read from the Hub API (?blobs=true)
#   spdx      licence id from the card; allowed: apache-2.0 mit bsd-3-clause
#   gated     the Hub's gated flag; must be false (the fetcher holds no token)
#   card      the model card URL the licence was read from

# DINOv3 (gated, custom), Stable Audio Open (gated, community), AudioLDM2
